configuration.learning: gain*(4*p*(1-p))*(1-ability) on practised skill; linear decay on other skills

interpretation: Training success is confounded by chosen task difficulty. Identical-standard latent probe is the synthetic learning comparison; stationary learners provide a no-learning control.
limitation: Synthetic model evidence only; no human learning efficacy, calibrated difficulty or operational competence claim.
policy_inputs: Only four Beta posteriors and processed outcome/history windows; latent skill is withheld from both policies

plastic_moderate_forgetting.interval_basis: Seed-level paired synthetic differences; approximate normal interval, not human efficacy

slow_learning_fast_forgetting.interval_basis: Seed-level paired synthetic differences; approximate normal interval, not human efficacy

stationary.interval_basis: Seed-level paired synthetic differences; approximate normal interval, not human efficacy
